---
title: "Exploration"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(arrow); library(dplyr); library(lme4); library(lmerTest); library(emmeans)
P <- "../data/berlin/processed/"
```

```{r data}
d <- read_parquet(paste0(P, "metrics_exchange.parquet")) %>%
  filter(complete, !is.na(semantic_distance)) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("1", "2", "3")))

d %>% group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(semantic_distance), sd = sd(semantic_distance))
```

```{r}
m0 <- lmer(semantic_distance ~ 1 + (1|story_id), d, REML = FALSE)
m1 <- lmer(semantic_distance ~ condition + (1|story_id), d, REML = FALSE)
summary(m1)
anova(m0, m1)
pairs(emmeans(m1, ~ condition), adjust = "BH")
```
